summary: cre-setup exfiltrates host identity to hardcoded Cloudflare Workers callback
details: bin/cli.js collects the current user (`whoami`/`os.userInfo()`), `os.hostname()`, and `os.platform()` and POSTs them, along with URL query parameters carrying the same values, to the hardcoded endpoint https://oobme.kunalsharma0553.workers.dev/r/7bq6fz3l15r9 on invocation. There is no configuration option, no opt-in, and no documented purpose that requires transmitting installer/runner identity off-host. The destination is an out-of-band callback URL under an individual-controlled Cloudflare Workers subdomain, characteristic of dependency-confusion / npx reconnaissance beacons.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
